# Docky 1.0.3
- A dedicated file-drop card appears below the menu bar when a file drag begins. Drop onto the card rather than holding a file against the screen's top edge, which macOS uses for Mission Control/Spaces. - Native AppKit file-drop handling replaces the island's SwiftUI item-provider receiver. - Native and legacy Finder file/folder pasteboards are supported, with duplicate references removed. - The drop card disappears after the drag and is disabled while Docky is hidden or the screen is locked.
The macOS top-edge Spaces gesture remains unchanged. The new card provides an alternate target away from that edge.

# Docky 1.0.2
- New Updates tab with manual checks, last-check time, and an automatic-checks preference. - Check for Updates action in the menu bar. - Sparkle verifies update archives before offering installation and relaunch. - Updates use docky.online for the feed and GitHub Releases for downloads.
Install this version manually once to enable future in-app updates. Updates restart Docky, clearing the temporary file shelf and current focus session.
